title: fix(lane): lane drop ignores a staged task deletion when it looks for the only copy of a record
body:
Evidence: cross-model audit 2026-11-20 d7; reproduction .krn/tmp/gemini/d7.test.ts exits 1 on main bb545b1.
Outcome: dropLane with a staged 'D  tasks/<id>.json' absent from main does not refuse with exit 64 (src/cli/lane.ts soleTaskRecords).
Proof: the reproduction becomes a regression test that fails by assertion on the base source and passes with the change.
